input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for reporting the sagging shed door at Flat 13, 103 Meadow Row, Bellmere, ZZ3 7ZZ (ref R/PM049-1).

The landlord is happy for you to lift and adjust the door yourself, as you offered. Please only do this if you can do so safely – for example, don't force the door or strain yourself lifting it, and leave it if the hinges or frame are loose, rotten or coming away.

Could you reply to let us know whether it's sorted? If you can't fix it, or it gets worse, just tell us and we'll arrange for a contractor to attend.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
